episodes.title: Escaping a Cult: Faith After Spiritual Abuse and Isolation
episodes.description: Peter Young spent almost twenty years surviving a cult inside his own family, and he didn't know it was happening until it was almost too late. Peter Young is the author of Stop the Tall Man, Save the Tiger, and he joins the pod to talk about the man his family called Uncle Robert, and how one person slowly took control of a marriage, a family, and twenty years of his life. We get into: 🔹 How a family gets pulled into a cult without ever "joining" one 🔹 The guilt and shame cult leaders use to keep control 🔹 What it actually took to get out 🔹 Rebuilding faith and reclaiming a family afterward If you've ever wondered how something like this could happen to someone without them realizing, or you're trying to make sense of something similar in your own life, this conversation might give you a starting point, and, more importantly, hope.
